title: Classical Variation
intro: 3.Nc3 or 3.Nd2: take on e4, develop with ...Bf5 and keep the bishop on its diagonal.
variation: e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 b1c3, e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 b1d2

lessons.title: 3...dxe4 and 4...Bf5
lessons.summary: Take on e4, then develop with a threat.

steps.text: 3.Nc3 defends e4 with a piece.
Take on e4.
steps.ifWrong: 3...dxe4: the knight takes back, and you gain time by attacking it.
steps.ifRight: White takes back with the knight.

steps.text: 4.Nxe4 recaptures. The knight stands in the centre.
Develop with a threat.
steps.hint: Your light-squared bishop can hit e4.
steps.ifRight: This is the Classical. ...e6, ...Nd7 and ...Ngf6 follow.

feedback.b8d7: 4...Nd7 is a good line too. This repertoire plays the Classical 4...Bf5.
feedback.g8f6: 4...Nf6 is playable, but this repertoire develops with a threat: 4...Bf5.

steps.text: White can also defend e4 with 3.Nd2.
Take on e4 here too: 3...dxe4.
4.Nxe4 gives the same position as after 3.Nc3.
This came from 3.Nd2. Find the developing move with a threat.

feedback.b8d7: 4...Nd7 is a good line too. This repertoire plays the Classical 4...Bf5.
feedback.g8f6: 4...Nf6 is playable, but this repertoire develops with a threat: 4...Bf5.

lessons.title: 5.Ng3 Bg6 and 6...Nd7
lessons.summary: Keep the bishop, then stop Ne5.

steps.text: 5.Ng3 attacks your bishop.
Keep the bishop on the same diagonal.
steps.ifWrong: 5...Bg6 keeps the bishop on its long diagonal.
steps.ifRight: It still watches the diagonal towards b1.

steps.text: 6.Nf3 develops. It also eyes e5, where it would hit your bishop.
Stop Ne5 before it comes.
steps.hint: A knight move that covers e5.

steps.text: Your bishop is outside the pawn chain, and ...e6 next will not shut it in.
Here White started with 3.Nd2. Find the move that stops Ne5.
steps.hint: A knight move that covers e5.
steps.ifRight: Move orders change; the plan does not.

lessons.title: The h4 push: make room with ...h6
lessons.summary: Give the bishop h7 before h5 can chase it.

steps.text: 6.h4 wants to push on to h5 and chase your bishop.
Give your bishop a square to retreat to.
steps.hint: Move a pawn so h7 becomes free.
steps.ifRight: If White plays h5, the bishop drops back to h7 and keeps its diagonal.

steps.text: 7.Nf3 develops.
Stop Ne5 again.
steps.hint: A knight move that covers e5.
steps.ifRight: The same set-up as before, with the h-pawns pushed.

steps.text: White can also push at once with 7.h5.
Keep the bishop on its diagonal.
steps.ifWrong: 7...Bh7 keeps the bishop on its diagonal.
steps.ifRight: The bishop is safe on h7 and still eyes the diagonal.

steps.text: Here White played 6.Nf3 Nd7 7.h4. Find the answer.
steps.hint: Make room for the bishop on h7.
